      TENNISNOTE_SINGLE_SHEET_IMPORT_MODE: apply

      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Require exact successful development caller and project scope
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_DEV_SUPABASE_FINGERPRINT: "63350140ffe5"
          EXPECTED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_FINGERPRINT: ${{ vars.DEV_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_FINGERPRINT }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, os, subprocess, sys
          def fail():
              print('development_deploy_scope_mismatch', file=sys.stderr)
              raise SystemExit(1)
          if os.environ.get('GITHUB_EVENT_NAME') != 'push' or os.environ.get('GITHUB_REF') != 'refs/heads/dev': fail()
          if subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip() != os.environ.get('GITHUB_SHA'): fail()
          url = os.environ.get('TENNISNOTE_SUPABASE_URL', '').strip().lower().rstrip('/')
          ref = url.removeprefix('https://').removesuffix('.supabase.co')
          if not url.startswith('https://') or not url.endswith('.supabase.co') or not ref or '.' in ref or '/' in ref: fail()
          project = hashlib.sha256(ref.encode()).hexdigest()
          if not project.startswith(os.environ['EXPECTED_DEV_SUPABASE_FINGERPRINT']): fail()
          account = os.environ.get('CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID', '')
          expected = os.environ.get('EXPECTED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_FINGERPRINT', '')
          if not account or not expected or hashlib.sha256(account.encode()).hexdigest() != expected: fail()
          print('development_deploy_scope_verified')
          PY

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Build isolated development sites
        run: |
          python scripts/build_cloudflare_pages.py --target member --output dist/member-dev
          python scripts/build_cloudflare_pages.py --target admin --output dist/admin-dev

      - name: Verify development deployment configuration
        run: |
          grep -q '"environment": "development"' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"enabled": false' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"developmentEmailSignIn": true' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"emailPasswordAuthUi": false' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"singleSheetImportMode": "apply"' dist/admin-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"singleSheetImportReverseEnabled": true' dist/admin-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '개발계 · 실제 결제·푸시 차단' dist/member-dev/index.html
          grep -q '개발계 · 실제 결제·푸시 차단' dist/admin-dev/index.html

      - name: Require existing Cloudflare Pages development projects
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, sys, urllib.parse, urllib.request
          account = os.environ.get('CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID', '')
          token = os.environ.get('CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN', '')
          if not account or not token:
              print('development_pages_presence_unconfirmed', file=sys.stderr)
              raise SystemExit(1)
          projects = {}
          page = 1
          while True:
              url = f'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{urllib.parse.quote(account, safe="")}/pages/projects?page={page}&per_page=100'
              request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'})
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
                      payload = json.load(response)
              except Exception:
                  print('development_pages_presence_unconfirmed', file=sys.stderr)
                  raise SystemExit(1)
              if payload.get('success') is not True or not isinstance(payload.get('result'), list):
                  print('development_pages_presence_unconfirmed', file=sys.stderr)
                  raise SystemExit(1)
              projects.update({item.get('name'): item for item in payload['result'] if isinstance(item, dict)})
              pages = payload.get('result_info', {}).get('total_pages')
              if not isinstance(pages, int) or pages < page or pages > 100:
                  print('development_pages_presence_unconfirmed', file=sys.stderr)
                  raise SystemExit(1)
              if page >= pages: break
              page += 1
          required = {'tennisnote-app-dev', 'tennisnote-admin-dev'}
          if not required <= projects.keys():
              print('development_pages_project_missing', file=sys.stderr)
              raise SystemExit(1)
          if any(projects[name].get('production_branch') != 'dev' for name in required):
              print('development_pages_branch_mismatch', file=sys.stderr)
              raise SystemExit(1)
          print('existing_development_pages_verified')
          PY

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""기존 DEV Pages만 읽기 검증하며 실패 사유에 비밀값을 포함하지 않는다."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PROJECTS = ("tennisnote-app-dev", "tennisnote-admin-dev")
DEV_PROJECT_FINGERPRINT = "63350140ffe5"
REPOSITORY = "leisurewang0827/tennis-note-public"
CALLER_WORKFLOW = REPOSITORY + "/.github/workflows/tennisnote-public-ci.yml@refs/heads/dev"


class ScopeError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def require(condition: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise ScopeError(reason)


def validate_context(env: dict[str, str], head: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    require(env.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY") == REPOSITORY
            and env.get("TENNISNOTE_CALLER_WORKFLOW_REF") == CALLER_WORKFLOW,
            "development_caller_mismatch")
    require(env.get("GITHUB_EVENT_NAME") == "push" and env.get("GITHUB_REF") == "refs/heads/dev"
            and bool(re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{40}", head)) and env.get("GITHUB_SHA") == head,
            "development_source_context_mismatch")
    require(env.get("TENNISNOTE_ENVIRONMENT") == "development"
            and env.get("TENNISNOTE_PAYMENTS_ENABLED") == "false"
            and env.get("TENNISNOTE_PAYMENT_MODE") == "disabled"
            and env.get("TENNISNOTE_BANK_TRANSFER_ENABLED") == "false"
            and env.get("TENNISNOTE_ALLOWED_PAYMENT_METHODS", "") == "",
            "development_runtime_mismatch")
    url = env.get("TENNISNOTE_SUPABASE_URL", "").strip().lower().rstrip("/")
    match = re.fullmatch(r"https://([a-z0-9-]+)\.supabase\.co", url)
    require(bool(match), "development_project_unconfirmed")
    fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(match.group(1).encode()).hexdigest()
    require(fingerprint.startswith(DEV_PROJECT_FINGERPRINT), "development_project_mismatch")
    account = env.get("CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID", "")
    expected = env.get("EXPECTED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_FINGERPRINT", "")
    require(bool(re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", expected)), "development_account_fingerprint_missing")
    require(bool(re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{32}", account)) and
            hashlib.sha256(account.encode()).hexdigest() == expected,
            "development_account_mismatch")
    require(bool(env.get("CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN")), "development_api_access_missing")
    return account, expected


def verify_existing_projects(get) -> dict[str, str]:
    rollbacks = {}
    for name in PROJECTS:
        result = get("/pages/projects/" + name)
        require(result.get("success") is True and isinstance(result.get("result"), dict),
                "development_project_presence_unconfirmed")
        project = result["result"]
        require(project.get("name") == name and project.get("production_branch") == "dev",
                "development_pages_branch_mismatch")
        result = get("/pages/projects/" + name + "/deployments?env=production&per_page=1")
        require(result.get("success") is True and isinstance(result.get("result"), list)
                and len(result["result"]) == 1, "development_rollback_unconfirmed")
        deployment = result["result"][0]
        require(deployment.get("environment") == "production"
                and deployment.get("latest_stage", {}).get("status") == "success"
                and deployment.get("deployment_trigger", {}).get("metadata", {}).get("branch") == "dev"
                and bool(re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9-]{36}", str(deployment.get("id", "")))),
                "development_rollback_unconfirmed")
        rollbacks[name] = deployment["id"]
    return rollbacks


def validate_source() -> dict:
    # 새 exact outer 후보를 기존 Auth authority로 복원한 뒤 원래 검사를 유지한다.
    # actual release는 별도로 새 outer freeze와 비교한다. 어느 쪽도 추정하지 않는다.
    from check_tennisnote_dev_prod_alignment import restore_r3_auth548_base
    composed = json.loads((ROOT / "tests/fixtures/r3-after-auth548-outer-parity.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    port = json.loads((ROOT / "tests/fixtures/verified-profile-phone-source-parity.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for row in port["authReconciliation"]["files"]:
        source = (ROOT / row["path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
        source = restore_r3_auth548_base(row["path"], source)
        current = next((item for item in port["sessionLoss"]["files"] if item["path"] == row["path"]), row)
        require(hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest() == current["afterFileSha256"], "auth_source_parity_mismatch")
    release_text = (ROOT / "app/release.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    release = json.loads(release_text)
    previous_release = json.loads(restore_r3_auth548_base("app/release.json", release_text))
    freeze = json.loads((ROOT / "tests/fixtures/auth-only-development-prepare-source-parity.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    require(previous_release["version"] == freeze["release"]["version"]
            and previous_release["releaseId"] == freeze["release"]["releaseId"], "development_release_mismatch")
    require(release["version"] == composed["candidateRelease"]["version"]
            and release["releaseId"] == composed["candidateRelease"]["releaseId"], "composed_release_mismatch")
    return {"version": release["version"], "releaseId": release["releaseId"]}


def main() -> int:
    try:
        head = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
        account, fingerprint = validate_context(dict(os.environ), head)
        release = validate_source()
        token = os.environ["CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"]

            request = urllib.request.Request("https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/" +

                    return json.load(response)
